name: check
summary: This EA monitors existing open positions and closes them when profit or loss reaches a user-defined percentage of the account balance. It does not open any new trades itself; it only acts as a risk/reward manager for positions opened manually or by other EAs. The profit and loss thresholds are calculated dynamically based on the current account balance.
summary_zh: 这个EA监控已有持仓，当盈利或亏损达到用户设定的账户余额百分比时自动平仓。它本身不开仓，仅作为其他持仓的风险/收益管理工具。盈亏阈值根据当前账户余额动态计算。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是作为持仓的盈亏监控器，而非独立的交易策略。入场条件方面，EA本身不产生任何入场信号，仅依赖于外部手动或其他EA开仓后进行监控。出场条件为：当持仓盈利达到账户余额的ProfitPercentage（默认2%）时平仓获利，或当亏损达到RiskPercentage（默认1%）时止损平仓。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及任何仓位计算或开仓逻辑。资金管理方面，盈亏阈值基于AccountBalance动态计算，但存在重大缺陷——盈亏金额以货币单位计算，而currentProfit的计算使用了Point()将价格差转换为点值，两者单位不匹配，导致逻辑错误。此外，EA缺少对持仓魔术号码的过滤，可能误关其他EA的仓位。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA's strategy concept is to act as a profit/loss monitor for existing positions rather than an independent trading strategy. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate any entry signals itself; it only monitors positions opened manually or by other EAs. Exit conditions are: close a position when its profit reaches ProfitPercentage (default 2%) of account balance, or when its loss reaches RiskPercentage (default 1%) of account balance. For position sizing, the EA has no position calculation or opening logic whatsoever. In terms of money management, the profit/loss thresholds are dynamically calculated based on AccountBalance, but there is a critical bug — the profit/loss amount is in currency units while currentProfit is calculated using Point() which converts the price difference to point value, creating a unit mismatch that renders the logic fundamentally broken. Additionally, the EA lacks magic number filtering, which means it may inadvertently close positions belonging to other EAs.

parameters.name: RiskPercentage
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比，达到此亏损比例时平仓
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade; closes position at this loss ratio

parameters.name: ProfitPercentage
parameters.description: 每笔交易的盈利百分比，达到此盈利比例时平仓
parameters.description_en: Profit percentage per trade; closes position at this profit ratio

pros: 简单直观的风险管理逻辑，盈亏比例可配置
动态基于账户余额计算阈值，适应资金变化
遍历持仓时使用倒序循环，避免索引错位问题
使用了标准库CTrade和CSymbolInfo，代码结构清晰
pros_en: Simple and intuitive risk management logic with configurable profit/loss ratios
Dynamically calculates thresholds based on account balance, adapting to equity changes
Uses reverse iteration when looping through positions, avoiding index shift issues
Leverages standard library CTrade and CSymbolInfo for clean code structure
cons: 致命单位不匹配Bug：currentProfit用Point()计算为点值，而riskAmount/profitAmount为货币金额，两者无法正确比较
缺少魔术号码过滤，会管理所有EA的持仓而非仅管理自身仓位
没有开仓逻辑，纯粹依赖外部开仓，作为独立EA功能不完整
没有考虑手续费和掉期费用，实际盈亏与阈值计算存在偏差
OnTick中每次都重新计算AccountBalance，高频调用但不缓存，效率低下
cons_en: Critical unit mismatch bug: currentProfit is calculated using Point() producing point values, while riskAmount/profitAmount are in currency units, making the comparison fundamentally incorrect
Lacks magic number filtering, managing all positions across all EAs instead of only its own
No entry logic whatsoever, purely dependent on external position opening, incomplete as a standalone EA
Does not account for commissions and swap fees, causing deviation between actual P&L and threshold calculations
Recalculates AccountBalance on every tick without caching, inefficient for high-frequency calls
improvements: 修复单位不匹配Bug：应使用PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)直接获取货币金额，而非手动用Point()计算
添加魔术号码输入参数，仅管理指定魔术号码的持仓，避免误关其他EA的仓位
考虑手续费和掉期费用，在盈亏计算中加入佣金和隔夜费的影响
improvements_en: Fix the unit mismatch bug: use PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT) to directly obtain the monetary profit amount instead of manually calculating with Point()
Add a magic number input parameter to filter and manage only positions with the specified magic number, preventing accidental closure of other EAs' positions
Factor in commissions and swap fees in the P&L calculation to reflect true net profit/loss

risk_points: 单位不匹配导致盈亏监控完全失效，可能在该平仓时未平仓，或不应平仓时错误平仓
缺少魔术号码过滤可能误关其他EA的盈利仓位
无手续费考虑可能导致实际亏损超出设定的风险百分比
risk_points_en: Unit mismatch causes the profit/loss monitoring to be completely non-functional, potentially failing to close positions when needed or incorrectly closing them when not needed
Lack of magic number filtering may accidentally close profitable positions from other EAs
Not accounting for commissions may cause actual losses to exceed the configured risk percentage
